audit_items.proof_trace: Phase 02c's resolved code_scope (grep_fallback, likely matched on the unrelated 'covers' field) points to process_effective_balance_updates, which only applies HYSTERESIS-based effective-balance updates during epoch processing and has no relation to quorums, stake weight, or the 1/3 threshold. The property (quorum_intersection_weight_lower) is a pure combinatorial lemma from the Gasper/lean4 formalization bounding the intersection weight of two 2/3 quorums by their combined weight minus their 1/3 thresholds -- a mathematical corollary of stake-weighted majority sets, not a discrete runtime guard enforced by any single pyspec function. A repo-wide search for the lemma's identifiers (quorum_2, quorum_intersection_weight_lower) and related helpers (third/actwt/extwt) found no corresponding implementation anywhere in the pyspec.
